# vit-l-p16_512x512_swag

Classification · `vit-l-p16_512x512_swag` · DX-APP Python example

Classification model, evaluated on ILSVRC2012.

**Input** 512 × 512 × 3 · **Dataset** ILSVRC2012 · **License** BSD-3-Clause · **Quantization** Q-Lite

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models vit_l_p16_512x512_swag
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/image_classification/vit/vit-l-p16_512x512_swag/vit-l-p16_512x512_swag_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/vit-l-p16_512x512_swag.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target vit-l-p16_512x512_swag_sync   # once
./bin/vit-l-p16_512x512_swag_sync \
  -m assets/models/vit-l-p16_512x512_swag.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_dog.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Raw · ONNX | 88.07 |
